title: Mock and Pattern (2018)
headline: No defect was found in Theorems 1 and 2 within the stated scope. This is not a proof that they are correct.

claims.label: Theorem 1
claims.gist: With four or more classes, two-way exchanges achieve the maximum number of transplants.
claims.statement: If there are at least four compatibility classes, some maximum exchange uses only two-way cycles.

result.summary: No pool needed a longer cycle among those checked.
result.search_scope: Exact search over all pools with four and five classes and up to twelve pairs.
result.limits: Pools with three or fewer classes are outside the claim.

vor_check.detail: Statement and definitions checked on rendered pages; the proof compared in extracted text only.

reproduction.detail: The evidence package reruns with one command (Python 3.12, standard library only).

claims.label: Theorem 2
claims.gist: The maximum can be found by a greedy pass over classes.
claims.statement: Processing compatibility classes in the stated order and matching greedily yields a maximum two-way exchange.

result.summary: The greedy pass matched the maximum in every pool checked.
result.search_scope: All pools in the search for Theorem 1.
result.limits: Larger pools rest on the constructive proof.

vor_check.detail: Statement and definitions checked on rendered pages; the proof compared in extracted text only.

reproduction.detail: The evidence package reruns with one command (Python 3.12, standard library only).
